note: OFFICIAL Graph API with a long-lived token (60 days), not the private API. MCPs based on instagrapi (username+password) were ruled out: Instagram detects them within hours and escalates to a permanent account ban. With WhatsApp that risk is acceptable because the phone number is disposable; a brand's Instagram account is NOT.
access: Standard Access is enough for the account's OWN OWNER and is auto-approved: reading and publishing work without an app review. Advanced Access (2-4 weeks of review) is only needed to operate OTHER people's accounts, i.e. if this gets sold as a product.
limits: 200 calls per hour. 25 posts per day. Images publish as JPEG.

get_media_posts.why_it_matters: This is THE reason for this connection: without reading what's already gone out, the agent writes blind — repeats topics and steps on what's published.

get_media_insights.why_it_matters: With this the agent learns what worked and what didn't, instead of guessing.

validate_access_token.what_it_does: Checks whether the token is still alive.
validate_access_token.note: The token lasts 60 DAYS and then expires silently. Letting the agent check it turns a silent failure into a warning.

get_content_publishing_limit.what_it_does: How many posts are left for the day.

business_discovery.what_it_does: Public data of another business account.
business_discovery.note: Useful for watching competitors without stepping outside the official API.

get_conversations.requires: instagram_manage_messages — Advanced Access. Does NOT work with Standard Access, not even on the account's own owner.

get_conversation_messages.what_it_does: The history of one message thread.
get_conversation_messages.requires: instagram_manage_messages — Advanced Access. Does NOT work with Standard Access.

publish_media.what_it_does: Publishes an image or video to the account.
publish_media.why_it_acts: It goes out under the client's brand and anyone can see it. It's public and immediate.

publish_carousel.what_it_does: Publishes a carousel of 2 to 10 pieces.

delete_comment.why_it_acts: It CANNOT be undone. And deleting an angry customer's comment, decided by an agent, is worse than the comment itself.

send_dm.requires: instagram_manage_messages — Advanced Access. Does NOT work with Standard Access.
